comments.author: Sakura
comments.body: I am really holding back when I think about how to answer "how to get crabs"...lol. Anyway, its collecting skill. I find them in northern European waters. My collecting spots were off of Helder & Hamburg. You should get them starting at r2, but not very plentiful. More brine until you get to about r5.
